question: What division into groups of eight is sought to be known fully?
premises: A division into eight groups of eight is mentioned
The speaker seeks to know it fully
The knowing is described as without limit
inference: The speaker seeks complete and exhaustive knowledge of the division into eight groups of eight.
uncertainties: anantathā may mean endlessly or in infinite detail
plain_english: I wish to know fully and without limit the division into eight groups of eight.
